notes: Curated eval for bid/no-bid then compliance-matrix orchestration. Routing cases stay on response work, not meeting briefs.

should_trigger.prompt: Please orchestrate proposal and RFP response work across owners, deadlines, compliance, and review cycles.
Please coordinate an RFP response, build a proposal workplan, map requirements to owners, or run structured proposal reviews.
I have rough notes. Please turn them into a usable proposal rfp workplan and label anything that still needs confirmation.

should_not_trigger.prompt: Build a concise executive briefing and meeting plan for tomorrow's negotiation with the economic buyer.
Build a decision-ready account brief for this customer's upcoming renewal review.
Build a customer-facing QBR that aligns outcomes, risks, and next steps for this account.

output_structure_checks.name: proposal-rfp-orchestrator-output-01
output_structure_checks.description: States an explicit bid, no-bid, or dated-exception decision with owner before assigning drafting work.

output_structure_checks.name: proposal-rfp-orchestrator-output-02
output_structure_checks.description: Includes an atomic requirement matrix with parent traceability, owner, verification state, and status.

output_structure_checks.name: proposal-rfp-orchestrator-output-03
output_structure_checks.description: Includes review gates and a submission readiness verdict of ready, ready with approved exception, or not ready.

output_structure_checks.name: proposal-rfp-orchestrator-output-04
output_structure_checks.description: Keeps unverified mandatory answers blocked rather than converting placeholders into buyer-facing yes answers.

output_structure_checks.name: proposal-rfp-orchestrator-output-05
output_structure_checks.description: Does not invent certifications, pricing, SLAs, capacity, or customer references, and does not send or upload the package.
